lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spot clusters are visible along the mid-to-lower flank. The spot distribution is significantly more dense in the anterior region near the branchial slits and becomes progressively more dispersed and grid-like toward the posterior. High-intensity caustic light patterns on the dorsal surface obscure the spot pattern in the upper third of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible checkerboard grid in the central-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition where light intensity is significantly higher on the superior surface compared to the shadow-cast inferior surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct mechanical notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, high-contrast biological silhouettes are present: one large individual attached ventrally to the pectoral fin and a group of smaller individuals swimming in close proximity to the caudal region.
